title: Company built in public contracts spent lavishly on luxury trips – The Mészáros Files, Part II
content:
Huge sums were spent on luxury hotels abroad, yachting, and parties featuring cigars and alcohol at Lőrinc Mészáros’s railroad construction company, which derived its revenue primarily from Hungarian government projects. Documents obtained by Direkt36 also shed light on one of the secrets behind the private jets that have been widely reported in the press.

title: Inside the Orbán Government’s Space War
content:
Experts in foreign policy and defence in Hungary’s previous government drew up a plan for the country to develop its own satellite programme. Viktor Orbán liked the idea, but according to an investigation by Direkt36, he later handed the project to 4iG, a company with close ties to the Fidesz government, despite internal opposition.

title: Here is the detailed data on hospital-acquired infections
content:
Last year almost 7,000 infections causing severe diarrhoea occurred in Hungarian hospitals, and 103 outbreaks happened within their walls. According to the statistics published on Thursday by the public health centre, there are enormous differences even between institutions with similar profiles. The standard of the work aimed at preventing infections can vary greatly from one institution to another.

title: Government reveals extensive data on hospital-acquired infections
content:
In a complete turnaround from its former secretive attitude, the National Centre for Public Health and Pharmacy will publish datasets of hospital-acquired infections by Friday morning and make it searchable on an interactive platform. Every year these infections cause unnecessary suffering and serious complications for thousands of hospital patients, yet so far there has been no success in curbing their spread.

title: Starvation Led to Sexual Abuse at a Children’s Home—Here Are the Orbán Government’s Concealed Child Protection Reports
content:
The previous Hungarian government launched inspections at children’s homes after it came to light that then President Katalin Novák had pardoned the accomplice of a convicted pedophile (both men had worked at such an institution). The reports, however, remained confidential. Direkt36 has now obtained the documents, which detail serious shortcomings and appalling conditions.

title: A devastating hospital report hidden from the public for a decade under the Orbán government
content:
At least ten years ago, the Orbán government already had documentation showing that the healthcare system was struggling with systemic problems, yet they never spoke about this openly. According to a document obtained by Direkt36, as early as 2015 not a single Hungarian hospital met the required operational standards.
